headline: Argentina's Vista Energy Boosts Q3 Output 33% as EBITDA Rises to $841.5M
summary: Vista Energy lifted daily oil and gas output by 33% to 169,023 boed in Q3 2026. Adjusted EBITDA jumped 78% to $841.5 million, while net income fell 7%.
why: Vista Energy is one of the primary independent shale producers in Argentina's Vaca Muerta basin, a key driver of Latin American energy exports.

impacts.name: Vista Energy
impacts.why: Production growth of 33% and a 78% jump in EBITDA highlight strong operational cash generation.
